enchantments.tooltip: +13 Enhancement Bonus: +13 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Reinforced Fists: This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one die.
Evil Outsider Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt monsters that bring ill intent from other planes, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Evil Outsiders.

Sovereign Banishing: On Hit: 4 to 24 Bane damage to Outsiders.On Vorpal Hit: If an outsider struck by this weapon has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the outsider has above 3000 Hit Points, it takes 300 damage.

Glass Jaw Strike: While wearing this item, when you roll a 20 on an unarmed attack, you will deal a tremendous blow to your target that will daze it (as the Sap ability) and may knock it down as well.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
